thread.title_full: Hawaiʻi sailing team sweeps top five at Fleet Race Invite in Honolulu

author: a. j. zhao
title: Hawaiʻi sailing team sweeps top five at Fleet Race Invite in Honolulu
text:
The University of Hawaiʻi sailing team swept the top five positions at the inaugural Hawaiʻi Fleet Race Invite, held March 28-29 at Keʻehi Lagoon in Honolulu. All five teams fielded by Hawaiʻi finished ahead of visiting squads from Arizona State, UC San Diego, and UNC Wilmington.
The strong showing highlights the depth of talent on the Rainbow Sailors roster as they prepare for upcoming championship events. Over two days and 16 races, each team competed in A and B divisions against a total field of eight teams.
The regatta began with harsh winds that led to several capsizes but allowed for ten sets to be completed on Saturday. Sunday brought lighter conditions and six more races under sunny skies. The Rainbow Green team claimed first place overall with a regatta-low 148 points, featuring an all-underclassmen lineup that placed in the top three in 13 out of their 20 races and won two events. William Bagley and Leila Landay sailed for A division while Christopher Daher skippered B division alongside Seaena Charlton and Lily Beckerman.
In second place was the Rainbows team with 180 points, thanks largely to Erik Anderson and Amanda Turner sweeping their first eleven A division races and placing among the top three through fourteen rounds. Spencer Fleming skippered B division for Jenna Englehart and TePua Ho. The Rainbow Black squad took third with steady performances from Everett McAvoy, Alister Muto (A division), Sam Bartlett, and Olivia Merz (B division).
Rainbow Wahine secured fourth place with an all-women lineup totaling 243 points; Martha Schuessler, Stella Taherian, Avery Hogue, Elin Reigstad (A division), Elizabeth Fourney, Kahlia Bailey (skippers), Peyton Lieser, and Kylie Alexander (B division) contributed throughout both divisions. Rounding out fifth was Rainbow White at 270 points featuring Arden Rathkopf/Ann Tokoyoda (A) plus Zach Brennan/Erin Wilmore (B).
With this sweep behind them, Hawaiʻi’s sailors look ahead to major championships: Rainbow Wahine will compete next at Lake Whatcom for the PCCSC Women’s Fleet Race Championship April 11-12 while coed teams head to Redwood City for PCCSC Team Race Championship April 4-5.
